recipe.visualDefinition: A mid-1960s album cover featuring a centered, soft-focus portrait of a woman with a voluminous copper-red bouffant hairstyle, framed by a thick white border with rounded corners. The layout uses a cream-colored background with heavy slab-serif display type at the top and a structured list of text on the left side of the portrait.
coreVisualRelationships: The heavy blue slab-serif text at the top anchors the composition against the light cream border.
The rounded white frame creates a 'window' effect, separating the subject from the outer margins.
The warm copper tones of the hair contrast with the cool blue of the jacket and the cream background.
coreInvariants: A thick white border with rounded corners containing the central image.
A high-volume 1960s hairstyle as the primary visual texture.
A muted, warm-toned color palette with a single cool accent color.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered portrait, medium close-up, occupying the right two-thirds of the inner frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bold slab-serif name at the top left/center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold blue header, moves down the left-aligned tracklist, and settles on the subject's eyes.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample cream-colored space on the left side of the inner frame to accommodate secondary text.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Copper-red hair and warm skin tones.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Medium blue for the primary header and the subject's jacket.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low-to-medium saturation with a high-key, bright exposure typical of 1960s studio photography.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and light sans-serif.
letterConstructionRules: Primary header uses ultra-bold slab serifs with square terminals and thick strokes.
Secondary title uses a decorative, slightly condensed serif with rounded terminals.
Body text uses a clean, all-caps geometric sans-serif.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' and 'G' in the header have very tight apertures and heavy horizontal weight.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme weight contrast between a heavy slab-serif display and a light, airy sans-serif body.
graphicDevices: Circular logo emblem at bottom left of inner frame

preserve: Slab serif style for the main name

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif weight and square terminals of the header.
Captures the mid-century geometric sans-serif feel for the tracklist.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a woman with a large 1960s copper-red bouffant hairstyle wearing a light blue jacket, set against a cream background. The image should be enclosed in a thick white border with rounded corners. Leave the left side of the inner frame relatively empty.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main name in a heavy blue slab-serif font at the top left. Add a list of song titles in a light, all-caps sans-serif font in the empty space on the left side of the inner frame.

verificationChecks: Is the border white with rounded corners?
Is the main header a heavy blue slab serif?
Is the subject's hair a prominent copper-red bouffant?
Is the secondary text all-caps and light-weight?

avoid: Modern sans-serifs like Arial or Helvetica

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the slab-serif text overlaps the top border slightly.
Check that the rounded corners of the frame are smooth and symmetrical.
Verify the color palette remains within the cream/copper/blue range.
Confirm the hair texture looks voluminous and period-accurate.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a soft-focus 60s portrait with a rounded-corner 'window' frame, then anchor the top with ultra-heavy slab-serif typography and the side with light geometric sans-serif lists.
